Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J29/J29nB223.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shanhui. Shanhui Huan owns the retained deployment, ruling the blessing is not only the one man's blessing and the realm at peace but gives every patched-robe under heaven eyes to see and ears to hear — tongue cut sooner than touch the sovereign's taboo.

Senses.Explanation: The one man's blessing of the Chan records: the throne's festive stamp — set on the New Year and the installation incense, granted by season-knowing monks, jabbed with, and ruled to open every patched-robe's eyes. Zhenjing Kewen, after the donor's gifting of a canon edition, hears the monk grant the one man's blessing with the myriad leaning on it and rules the monk knows the season well, Fushi Tongxian at the year's opening answers the blessing-line question with the one man's blessing, the myriad people leaning on it — gold branches forever thick through three thousand worlds, jade leaves ever spread through ten thousand ages — Minshu Ruxiang welds the formula to the buddha-choosing field: one man's blessing, myriad people staying, the choosing-field open, the emptied mind passing the list — and Konggu Daocheng at his Chongqing installation hangs the blessing on the succession: imperial sons and grandsons passing it on forever, the one man's blessing, loyal civil and military ministers honored generation after generation. Mingjue Cong in the palace hall hears the auspicious air rise — the hall of ten-thousand goods, the one man's blessing equal to heaven and earth — and answers that even so one must know the debt, Chaozong Tongren remembers the verse he once dared present his late teacher — the Hanlin academician soaked through, the war minister cold to the bone, no need to keep crying grievance face to face: the one man's blessing, the myriad people at ease — and the teacher's answering verse he then judged lacking in reserve, Muchen Daomin at the Tiantong installation wishes the one man's blessing and the realm at peace, every guest at the feast touching the unborn's purport, and Shanhui Huan rules the New Year blessing is not only the one man's blessing and the realm at peace but gives every patched-robe under heaven eyes to see and ears to hear — tongue cut sooner than touch the sovereign's taboo.
